hard_think: A fixed digest read from a pathname is insufficient against a local mutation race, so the parent and source file remain leased through parse and final reproof.
A byte-only parser result cannot truthfully claim a repository-reviewed pin or held source lease; independent review forced a separate private byte proof and public post-reproof admission.
Source admission is the smallest validated layer; directory publication, extraction, and dependency materialization remain a separate Phase 2C2 transaction.
dialectic_sweep: Using zipfile.ZipFile(path) was rejected because it reopens mutable path state and accepts a broader archive dialect than the reviewed artifact requires.
Treating PyPI comparison as authenticated provenance was rejected because no signature or transparency proof is bound.

The first green was rejected after independent reviews found six accepted Windows-illegal characters, false byte-seam authority, incomplete hostile tests, and missing generated/documentation bindings; every reproducible finding was corrected without weakening the claim.

A dedicated security subagent was blocked twice by the hosting cybersecurity gate and is not counted as completed evidence; architecture and test/scale verifiers covered the local defensive falsifiers.
first_principles: Admission proves only that one held byte image equals the reviewed pin and satisfies the exact inert wheel/distribution contract.
Internal parse evidence and public authority-bearing evidence require different types.
No future extraction, publication, import, execution, or activation property can be inferred from this receipt.

nonclaims: The reviewed pin is a repository decision, not authenticated official provenance, a signature, or a transparency-log proof.
The production admission API performs no network access, download, extraction, installation, publication, import, child execution, route change, owner change, or activation.
No builder-runtime authentication, pre-import loader authority, native-loader closure, subprocess closure, exact-runtime closure, deterministic-effects, or write-denial proof is claimed.
The 200-admission gate is bounded local repeatability/leak evidence, not production throughput, concurrency, or horizontal-scale proof.
No candidate build/reproof, HoloIndex A-grade, or retrieval-quality RSI promotion is claimed; Phase 2C2 remains blocked.
